questions.question:
Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are standing in a row. B is exactly in between F and D. E is standing in between A and C. A is not a neighbor of D and F. C is not a neighbor of D but immediate right of F.

F is standing in between which of the following pair?
questions.solution: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are standing in a row. As no information is given regarding which direction are these six persons facing, we consider all of them are facing North. 1. B is exactly in between F and D. 2. A is not a neighbor of D and F. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fe9be64d855badc31ded5a1a3254bc033e0c07f3db9b47e57ed0a80ca360d1f.png]

questions.question: Among 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F, it is known that; A is taller than at-least 3 persons. C is taller than B, who is taller than exactly 1 person. D is not shorter than C. E is taller than A and D is shorter than A. Who is 4th shortest person among all?
questions.solution:
6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F

1. A is taller than at-least 3 persons.

A > _ > _ > _ (Atleast)

2. C is taller than B, who is taller than exactly 1 person.

_ > _ > _ > C > B > _

3. D is not shorter than C.

D > C

4. E is taller than A and D is shorter than A.

E > A > D

Combining all the statements together, we get:

E > A > D > C > B > _

Only F is left, so it will take the vacant position.

So, the final arrangement is:

E > A > D > C > B > F

Hence, D is the 4th shortest person among all

questions.question: If in a certain way, 3 + 4 = 25 and 7 + 24 = 625, then find 9 + 40 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern is:

3 + 4 = 25 → 3² + 4² = 25

7 + 24 = 625 → 7² + 24² = 625

Similarly,

9 + 40 = → 9² + 40² = 81 + 1600 = **1681**

Hence, ‘1681’ is the correct answer

questions.question:
Study the following information carefully and answer the questions given below.

(i) Eight boys P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a circular table.

(ii) P and Q are sitting opposite to each other.

(iii) S is sitting second to the right of P and V is sitting second to the right of Q.

(iv) T and W are sitting opposite to each other.

(v) R is sitting between P and V.

What is the position of T with respect to Q?
questions.solution:
(i) Eight boys P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a circular table.

As no information is given regarding which direction are these eight persons facing, we consider all of them are facing inside the circle.

(ii) P and Q are sitting opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7bdf21457623a21fc5a95557c5adc9626da853502c294c47b9c65e9a0da02a7.png] 

(iii) S is sitting second to the right of P and V is sitting second to the right of Q. R is sitting between P and V

(iv) T and W are sitting opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a9572bd744fc6c3cc96756fab402549d855be358a6332a9119f04c62514d078.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d76e4c82e1f7d628ce732659476e2b1929385f8d5a9ea755719ae4682e66138.png] 

Now, U will occupy the only vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c0865fc0c994b5eb24d8163a055b6b361dc74284946be209438d89ee63b8827.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/707a1bd833396449f3b4cc656d8f7675fd56923541015cb60f8cd22cfa455a86.png] 

The position of T with respect to Q – there can be two answers:

1 - T is third to the left of Q (From Case I)

2 – T is immediate right of Q (From Case II) – But no such option is given

So, we consider the answer that comes from Case I.

Hence, T is third to the left of Q

**Statement:**

I. Some accountants are managers.

II. Some accountants are cashiers.

Conclusions:

I. All cashiers are accountants.

II. Some managers are accountants.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cab033f2178a8d11a4984119e71f742c174f81a3af098643adcfc05a20ab9ad0.png] 

I. All cashiers are accountants. → False

II. Some managers are accountants. → True

Hence, only conclusion II follows

questions.question:
In the following question, select the number which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 
 

 
 
24

 
 
 
61

 
 
 
49

 
 
 

 
 
56

 
 
 
94

 
 
 
66

 
 
 

 
 
32

 
 
 
?

 
 
 
61
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

(1st term + 3rd term – 2ⁿd term) = 1st term ÷ 2

In Row 1:

(49 + 24 – 61) = 24 ÷ 2

12 = 12

In row 2:

(56 + 66 – 94) = 56 ÷ 2

28 = 2

Similarly,

In row 3:

(32 + 61 – X) = 32 ÷ 2

93 – X = 16

X = 77

Hence, 77 is the correct answer.

questions.question:

9 : 28 : : 56 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

9 : 28 → 9 : (9 × 3) + 1

Similarly,

56 : ? → 56 : (56 × 3) + 1

? = 169

Hence, ‘169’ is the correct answer.
